_doc: The proven examples of the text forms the work packet carries (ssam_discover {packet:true}, work-packet.mjs, text-routes.mjs packetTextSection): one compact example per form, written as a model writes a creation (no @key, no ids).

Proven by kernel/tests/Shared/FlowApplyScenarios.cs ThePacketExamplesApplyInOneJob (FlowApplyTests in Anvil.Tests, FlowApplyOdcTests in Anvil.Tests.Odc): ssam-ddl/1 and ssam-flow/1 in ONE job with the user exception they raise, on the blank service fixture of the lane; ssam-html/1 with the text of the screen action it names, on the Reactive fixture. Each one reads back as the text written.
A form keeps one text for both lanes, or one per lane (o11, odc) where the lane writes a word of its own (site property / setting; an ODC app has no public server action).

ssam-flow/1.o11:
/// Lê o resumo de um pedido pelo número.
server action ObterPedidoResumo public
  in Numero: Text
  out Resumo: PedidoResumo
  GetPedido = aggregate FROM Pedido WHERE (Pedido.Numero = Numero) MAX 1
  if GetPedido.List.Empty:  # Pedido existe?
    raise PedidoNaoEncontrado("Pedido não encontrado")
  assign  # Montar o resumo
    Resumo.Numero = GetPedido.List.Current.Pedido.Numero
    Resumo.Total = GetPedido.List.Current.Pedido.Total
  end
